title: Ask makes the change straight away, and each change is one row you can turn off or delete
goal: When a person asks for something, Ask just does it. The Agent area keeps a short list, one row per request, saying in plain words what changed, with a switch to turn that change off and on and a way to delete it. The person never has to read or approve a list of steps.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-20: 'when I ask the agent to do something, I want it to auto run, but i need a way to undo the changes easily in the agent history. I don't need to see all the actions taken, i just need a row that explains the change and a way to toggle it or delete it.'

This overrides the mock agent-generate-wt.html (Run plan at line 345, the numbered plan rows) and the shipped Ask task ask-in-the-app-runs-on-a-local-model-with-no-mod, whose acceptance said nothing runs until Run plan. The user wins; the mock's Last change idea (line 558) is the closest thing to keep.

Toggle is the hard part: a change can add layers (hide or remove them) and also edit existing ones (set_layer, restyles). Think of each request as a recorded patch, the layers it added plus the before and after of every layer it edited, so it can be taken out and put back while later edits to other layers stay. Edits through History.perform as always. Decide how rows persist (with the document or for the session) and log why.
acceptance: Sending a request runs it with no Run plan step and no list of commands on screen
Each request leaves one row in the Agent area: a short plain sentence of what changed (for example 'Drew a dog' or 'Added 8 measurements'), newest at the top

The row's switch turns that change off (the document looks as if it was never made) and back on, without touching changes made after it; when a later change depends on it, the row says so in one short sentence instead of breaking anything
The row's delete removes the change for good. One Command Z still takes back the latest request whole

Tried at Next defaults with the try paths of the Ask audit (screenshot measurements, the Case 1 title page, the pricing section), each turned off, on and deleted, and checked against the read document each time

User copy is short and plain, no em dashes, no Claude or Anthropic. Audit under queue/audits/ with pictures of the rows and of a change turned off and on. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
